record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Can one find an integrable deformation of the N = 1 supersymmetric KdV system whose conserved quantities reproduce the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws that arise from the fourth-root structure of the Lax operator and behave as Poisson square roots of the usual local bosonic conservation laws?

evidence.quote: The sKdV equation represents the first example of an integrable system for which nonlocal conservation laws arise in such a clean form. In that respect, we introduce the first open problem (OP): OP-1: Find an integrable deformation that reproduces the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the N=1 supersymmetric KdV (sKdV) equation, written in terms of a fermionic superfield Φ(x,θ,t) = ξ(x,t) + θ u(x,t), where θ is a Grassmann-odd coordinate and ξ is a fermionic field while u is bosonic. The sKdV equation
Φ_t = -Φ_{xxx} + 3(Φ D Φ)_x,
with D = ∂_θ + θ ∂_x the supercovariant derivative, admits a Lax representation L_t = [P,L] with super Lax operator L = ∂_x^2 - (DΦ) - Φ D. Fractional (in particular fourth-root) powers L^{1/4} of L give rise to an infinite tower of fermionic nonlocal conserved quantities that behave as "Poisson square roots" of the standard local bosonic conserved quantities of sKdV, in the sense that their pairwise Poisson brackets reproduce the local bosonic conservation laws.

Problem: Construct an integrable deformation of the N=1 sKdV equation (i.e. an integrable evolution system that reduces to sKdV in an appropriate limit) whose set of conserved quantities includes, as genuine local or naturally encoded conservation laws of the deformed system, the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws of sKdV arising from the fourth-root structure of L and preserving the Poisson square-root relation with the local bosonic ones.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has elaborated on the nonlocal fermionic conservation laws of N=1 sKdV via fractional powers of the Lax operator and constructed associated flow equations and hierarchies (e.g., Dargis–Mathieu and later works on supersymmetric integrable hierarchies with half-integer gradation, plus recent 2025 work on negative-grade solitonic sectors). However, no clearly identified construction of an integrable deformation of N=1 sKdV that promotes these specific fermionic nonlocal conservation laws to conserved quantities of the deformed system was found, so the status remains unclear.

status_evidence.title: Non-local Conservation Laws and Flow Equations for Supersymmetric Integrable Hierarchies
status_evidence.snippet: Infinite series of Grassmann-odd and -even flow equations are defined; non-local conserved quantities are constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Related fermionic nonlocal conserved quantities have been further developed but not as conservation laws of a deformed sKdV.

status_evidence.title: New negative grade solitonic sector for supersymmetric KdV and mKdV hierarchies
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) study of new sectors of the sKdV hierarchy.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on sKdV hierarchy structure, suggesting the deformation problem is not settled in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Higher order supersymmetries and fermionic conservation laws of the supersymmetric extension of the KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Fermionic conservation laws of sKdV from fractional powers of the Lax operator.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws that the problem asks to be promoted by a deformation.
